reason: The primitive tetragonal cell is strongly supported by indexing, but the submitted exact P1 realization is not. The comparable whole-pattern report is unavailable, no Rwp or full-profile refinement was reported, and the trajectory optimized extracted reflection intensities with a custom objective while instantiating only a limited set of symmetry models and one P1 topology. Its own calculated intensities substantially miss important lines (for example, observed/calculated relative intensities are about 18.25/10.9 at 29.09 degrees and 12.47/8.36 at 31.86 degrees). More decisively, the P1 coordinates are physically implausible despite reasonable Si-O distances and nominal 4/2 coordination: O-Si-O angles span about 50-157 degrees, Si-O-Si angles about 95-114 degrees, O-O contacts reach 1.38 angstrom, and Si-Si contacts reach 2.26 angstrom. Thus the evidence supports the cell and nominal composition far more than Z, symmetry, and coordinates, and a materially different, scientifically motivated structure could plausibly improve the candidate set.
